settings.quote: I came for biology and stayed for the river. By sophomore year I was running my own water samples with Professor Calloway, and nobody treated me like I was too new to help.
settings.name: Maya Lindgren, class of 2027

settings.headline: Come see Larkmoor for yourself
settings.text: Visit on a weekday for a student-led tour and a class, or come to the Fall Open House on October 17. There are no application or sign-up forms on this demo site.
